requirements.label: intermediate
requirements.title: Intermediate Spanish Language Courses

rules.text: Equivalent proficiency satisfied through permission of the department or through the placement or the challenge exam
rules.reason: Placement, challenge exam, and departmental permission are not course-based and cannot be checked from a transcript

requirements.sourceText: There are several ways to satisfy this requirement. Please choose one of the four options listed below depending on your proficiency and/or interests: SPN 211 - Intermediate Spanish I 3 credits and SPN 212 - Intermediate Spanish II 3 credits OR SPN 214 - Intermediate Medical Spanish I 3 credits and SPN 215 - Intermediate Medical Spanish II 3 credits OR SPN 213 - Intermediate Spanish for Speakers of Spanish 3 credits OR equivalent proficiency satisfied through permission of the department or through the placement or the challenge exam.

requirements.label: advanced
requirements.title: Required Advanced Courses (9 credits)
requirements.sourceText: SPN 311 - Spanish Conversation and Composition 3 credits OR SPN 310 - Spanish Grammar and Composition for Students of Hispanic-American Background 3 credits; SPN 312 - Introduction to Literary Studies 3 credits; SPN 321 - Advanced Spanish Grammar and Composition 3 credits

requirements.label: elective
requirements.title: Elective Advanced Courses (9 credits)
requirements.sourceText: THREE other upper-division (i.e., 300-level or higher) SPN courses, one of which must be at the 400 level. S/U graded courses such as SPN 475 and SPN 488 do not count towards fulfillment of this requirement.

requirements.label: total-credits
requirements.title: Total minor credits

rule.text: Completion of the minor requires 18-24 credits, depending on language placement
rule.reason: Program-wide total credit range depends on placement; no rule type expresses a total-credit range across requirements

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 18-24 credits, depending on language placement (see note 1 below).

policies.sourceText: All courses in Spanish offered to fulfill minor requirements must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.
All courses in Spanish offered to fulfill minor requirements must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.
At least nine credits of upper-division Spanish courses must be earned at Stony Brook to complete the minor.

notes.text: Entering students who wish to continue the study of Spanish started in high school should consult a departmental advisor to help them choose the appropriate course (Placement).

Students with enough language proficiency to satisfy the intermediate requirement complete a total of 18 credits. Students who need SPN 211 and SPN 212, or SPN 214 and SPN 215, complete a total of 24 credits. Students with a Spanish-speaking background can begin the minor by taking SPN 213 or SPN 310, depending on their Spanish written proficiency.

Students wishing to major in Spanish should consult with a Departmental advisor. The Department also offers a major in Spanish language and literature (Bachelor of Arts); this page covers the minor only.
